reviews.comment:
Un lugar que tiene todo lo que el asociado necesita, amplio buffet, sanitarios impecables, atencion buena en la parte combustibles, cocheras a buen precio, todo ello en el vorazon de Bahia Blanca, es decir pleno centro a dos cuadras de la plaza principal. Ahhhhh, la atencion en la Administracion, muy merituable, excelente, para destacar!!!

(Translated by Google)
A place that has everything a member needs: a large buffet, spotless restrooms, good service at the fuel station, reasonably priced parking, all in the heart of Bahia Blanca, right downtown, just two blocks from the main square. And the service at the administration office is truly commendable, excellent, and deserves special mention!
